question: How many customers are in Germany?

answer_sql:
SELECT
  COUNT(*) AS how_many_customers
FROM contoso_served.dim_customer AS c
WHERE
  c.country_code = 'DE'
  AND c.valid_from <= (
    SELECT
      MAX(order_date)
    FROM contoso_served.v_contoso5_sales_line
  )
  AND c.valid_end > (
    SELECT
      MAX(order_date)
    FROM contoso_served.v_contoso5_sales_line
  )
